name: LEVEL_EXIT_NEXT
meaning: Cine::Finish (CINE_LEVEL_EXIT) and Fade_Update set it; Level_ExitUpdate finishes the level

name: LEVEL_EXIT_DEMO
meaning: Scene_Wheel sets it; Level_ExitUpdate starts the attract demo

name: LEVEL_EXIT_TO_MENU
meaning: PauseMenu_Exit sets it; Level_ExitUpdate calls Level_FinishScene(0)

name: LEVEL_EXIT_TRANSITION
meaning: Transition_Start sets it; tested by Level_ExitUpdate (inferred)

name: LEVEL_EXIT_RESTART
meaning: PauseMenu_Exit sets it; Level_ExitUpdate calls RestartScene
